text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey's Classic year has finally 
begun—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since the start of the new year, I'd been 
in the Trainer's office working toward the 
Classic Class...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Dream Journey was able to finish out 
her Junior year in fantastic fashion."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, she is by no means far enough 
ahead of the other Umamusume to be 
comfortable...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—There are many cases where Umamusume grow 
rapidly and blossom after entering the 
Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if you hold a lead during the Junior 
Class, it's common in racing for the 
hierarchy to change drastically in the 
Classic Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It feels like there's time, but there's 
none at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order for Dream Journey to achieve 
results in the Classic races, we have to 
desperately pile up everything we can do 
right now—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —You're working hard.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Good work, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Journey!? When did you get here...!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I did knock, you know? ...Though you 
seemed so engrossed you didn't notice.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Preparations for the Classic Triple 
Crown, is it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Working diligently without wasting a 
second is truly admirable, but... aren't 
you pushing yourself a bit too hard?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Hurrying our steps toward our destination 
to avoid the approaching rain clouds is 
important, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, choosing to stop in your tracks 
and wait things out is essential on a 
journey.
choice_data_list: Still, the time until spring is...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is limited. Which is precisely 
why—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Much like time, one's body is a limited 
resource on any journey; it must not be 
overtaxed too early. ...That is how I see 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Dream Journey's calm tone of voice, 
there seemed to be a quiet resolve that 
neatly compelled me to correct my 
unreasonable behavior.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's rational and very observant of 
others. If she's pointing it out, my 
fatigue might have unconsciously been 
showing...
choice_data_list:
...All right. We won't push any further 
today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for listening to my 
request.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, seeing as I suggested it, 
allow me to help you take a break.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for waiting. Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A pleasant aroma of coffee wafted over... 
It was specially brewed for me by Dream 
Journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With a single sip, a refreshing tartness 
and fruity flavor washed over me—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's my favorite brand, and I'm very glad 
to hear it suited your taste.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Once you've had that coffee and caught 
your breath, let's take a break.
choice_data_list: Huh? Isn't this coffee our break...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If you go right back to work after that, 
it doesn't count as resting, you know.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
When resting, it is crucial to completely 
switch your mindset. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Shall we play a little game to help you 
forget about work?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That being said, all we are playing 
is simple Old Maid. However, within it 
lies—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Let's add a "reward."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If I win, well... How about you tell me a 
few things you like about Sis, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—I will answer any one question you wish 
to ask.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...How about it? Care to give it a try?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Dream Journey has sharp insight. 
Winning this game will be easy for her. 
And she knows that better than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, she dared to make that proposal. 
What could her true motive possibly be? I 
don't know."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, that... piques my interest. 
This might be a chance to really get to 
know her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to understand Dream Journey better. 
Driven by that single thought, I 
challenged her to Old Maid—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Congratulations. Looks like it's your 
win, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After a nail-biting close battle, she 
somehow managed to win.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Then, as promised, here is your "reward." 
Trainer-san, please go ahead and ask me a 
question.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I shall answer whatever you ask.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I never expected to win, so I 
scramble to think. Even if they said 
'anything,' the only reasonable thing that 
came to mind was—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"My special skill? Well, in that case... 
As I mentioned before, perhaps my memory?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
""My memory is just slightly on the better 
side, you see.""

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"When I enrolled and saw you... I 
recognized who you were immediately."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, she did say that before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, compared to back 
then, it feels like Dream Journey has 
become a little easier to talk to..."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It may be plain, but put it to good use... 
and it will become a source of strength in 
unexpected ways.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: For instance...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
――"No, really, all I did was hand over a 
stepladder."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"'Overseas Support Committee?', 'Ah, 
hello,', 'A-Ah, yeah', 'Huh... I had no 
idea'—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"'Overseas Support Committee?', 'Ah, 
hello,', 'Y-Yeah', 'Huh... I had no 
idea'—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what made them say that out of 
the blue. Yet at the same time, I felt a 
strange sensation as if a drawer in my 
mind was being unlocked—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: “No, I don't have a trainee yet—”

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I see. My, my... I hope that serves as a 
good turning point for you."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I'll be quietly cheering you on, wishing 
you a fruitful time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I remember now. Every single word Dream 
Journey uttered was something I had once 
said myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, when I reunited with Dream 
Journey... not even knowing it was her—"
choice_data_list:
...Could you really remember every single 
one?
...Could you really remember all of it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I can memorize and reproduce every single 
interaction with you like this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even marvel at such an 
astounding special talent... a strange 
chill ran down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing in my past for which I 
should feel ashamed if remembered. I can 
say that with confidence. And yet, this 
is...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It seems I've surprised you. I don't 
remember literally everything, you know.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That day left quite an impression on me…… 
That is the only reason I haven't been 
able to forget it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
But you see... it's precisely because we 
remembered like this that we have who we 
are today.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"When you think about it like that... 
don't you think it's the ultimate 
'power'?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's true that memory power can become 
real "strength." Yes, I was made to feel 
that firsthand...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, Dream Journey and I played 
a game trying to remember what we did 
during each training session."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She answered every single one correctly, 
amply demonstrating that her memory was 
every bit the special talent she claimed—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Night. Back in my room, I reflect on 
today's interaction with Dream Journey.
choice_data_list: (All in all, it was a lot of fun...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My, that sounds like a question from a 
matchmaking interview.
choice_data_list: W-Wait, I didn't mean it like that...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm only joking.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Still, a hobby, is it? ...Well, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Social media, is it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Though I suspect it will be used quite 
differently from what you are imagining, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—In my case, I am not seeking connections 
on social media.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You could use it as a notepad to casually 
jot down daily thoughts, or—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I merely use it as a window to 
occasionally see what the world is talking 
about—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
As a tool that allows for one-way input 
and output, the feel of it is just right.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...It's a little strange, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
No, I think it just depends on how each 
person uses it

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't think social media is a place 
where one is strictly obligated to connect 
with others, either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So the one-sided approach she suggested 
shouldn't be completely out of the 
question either.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So that is how you feel about 
it, Trainer.
choice_data_list:
(But I wonder what they're writing 
about...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I find myself unable to stop wondering 
what her daily posts on her account are 
like.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —You're curious, aren't you? I understand.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I find myself curious about your social 
media too, Trainer, and check it all the 
time.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm just joking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Afterward, Dream Journey and I had a 
long, unhurried talk about how social 
media is used nowadays...—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Night. Back in my room, I reflect on 
today's interaction with Dream Journey.
choice_data_list: (All in all, it was a lot of fun...)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...That's a good question. Understanding 
what someone dislikes is also an important 
part of communication, after all.
choice_data_list: I-I didn't mean it like that...!
I-I didn't mean it like that...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm only joking.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...How convenient. Shall I show you the 
actual thing that I'm "not good with"?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: While drinking something warm, alright?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —This is what I struggle with.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To be precise... snow as in the 
weather, that is.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—The more snow falls, the more it hides 
away.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The path... the footprints... the 
sounds... The figure standing by my 
side... the destination... All of it—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...All forms of severe weather are great 
enemies on a journey. Though personally, I 
find snow to be the worst of all—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Relentlessly hiding what I am trying to 
see. That is... not to my liking.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—...That being said, I have no intention 
of denying anyone's appreciation for the 
elegance of snow.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, do you like snow?
choice_data_list: …If it's from inside a warm room, then…

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I see... that makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That answer sounds just like you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, Dream Journey and I 
continued having casual conversations 
while sipping on warm drinks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The words exchanged beneath the winter 
sky resonated only between the two of 
them, as if the falling snow had absorbed 
everything else..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Night. Back in my room, I reflect on 
today's interaction with Dream Journey.
choice_data_list: (All in all, it was a lot of fun...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Thanks to Dream Journey, I was able to 
forget about work today and enjoy a 
relaxing time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I was able to learn a lot of 
new things about her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps Dream Journey today had no hidden 
motive at all, and was simply showing me 
some genuine appreciation—"
choice_data_list: (...I feel a little bad about this.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt ashamed for suspecting, even for a 
moment, that she had an ulterior motive.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"For all the kindness she showed me today, 
I must repay her in full through my work 
as a Trainer...!"
choice_data_list:
(Starting tomorrow, I'll give it my all 
again...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling my motivation rise even higher, I 
began preparing for tomorrow—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —Orfe. How is your tea this evening?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Same as always.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That's good to hear. There's seconds, too.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Those playing cards.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah— I used it today, with my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ......Did you let them win again?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ……That's not true, Orfe.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I lose to you, it's always fair 
and square. ...Care to test that out?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not in the mood.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "My, my...— That's a bit of a shame."
